basics.name: Jeremy Malloch
basics.label: Machine Learning Engineer
basics.summary: Machine Learning Engineer specializing in perception systems for autonomous vehicles

work.name: Cruise
work.summary: Working on perception systems for autonomous vehicles
highlights: Unblocked Cruise's return to driverless operation by leading Unified Tracker V2 model release that resolved critical ultra-nearfield risks (largest perception risk area)
Contributed multiple modelling improvements to novel Unified Tracker V1 multi-modal, temporal tracking transformer model
Increased model flop utilization by 32%, stabilized training by analyzing model activation magnitudes, and reduced velocity flips by 20%
Created model attention metrics leading to 11% reduction in centroid error, 12% reduction in velocity error, and increased recall of pedestrians from 95.03% to 98.33%

work.name: Apple
work.summary: Building on device ML inference infra for autonomous vehicles
highlights: Contributed to machine learning compiler and inference framework, using C++ and Python
Researched & prototyped DNN quantization & sparsification pipeline, resulting in up to 40% faster runtime of deployed models

work.name: Cognitive Systems
work.summary: Developed ML models & inference tooling for WiFi based motion detectors
highlights: Achieved 60x improvement in neural network inference runtime by implementing im2col convolutions, vectorization and memory alignment with Eigen in C++ for ARM CPU (exceeded Tensorflow Lite baseline by 2x)
Researched & prototyped semi-supervised GAN data augmentation to reduce false positives
